snippet.title: Caramel Creek - Gameplay Trailer | Cozy Cafe Sim (Early Access Nov 12)
snippet.description:
Leave the city behind and turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe.

Caramel Creek is a small, personal cafe and life sim with pixel art, a warm soundtrack and a quiet town by the river. Inspired by Stardew Valley and Twin Peaks.

In the game:
- From seed to cup: plant coffee bushes, then roast, grind and brew
- A cafe with real customers, reviews and tips
- Repair the cafe with Sergei the handyman
- Neighbours with their own business: Kate's shop and Anastasia's workshop
- Chop trees, plant saplings and till the soil
- A skill tree, a living day and night, a weekday calendar
- Ostin the cat, who even rides the robot vacuum

Release: Early Access on Steam, November 12, 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672660

Languages: English, Russian
Platforms: Windows, Linux
Made by one person. Feedback shapes what comes next!
